nodes.label: Training decision point
nodes.rationale: Fine-tune only if hit@5 is good but answers fail on format/style or domain vocabulary; fine-tuning does not fix missing knowledge.

nodes.label: IntoResponse error mapping
nodes.rationale: Errors map to 400/502/500 with JSON body.

nodes.label: operationId
nodes.rationale: Dify uses operationId as the tool name.

nodes.label: axum
nodes.rationale: Chosen over actix-web/poem: from the tokio team, fits the tokio learning path.

nodes.label: Key hypothesis
nodes.rationale: Building RAG phase by phase teaches ownership, errors, traits, async, testing; validated when phase 5 eval passes and the user wrote all Rust.

nodes.label: Rust RAG service
nodes.rationale: One Rust HTTP service built phase by phase: ingest → chunk → embed → store → retrieve → generate.

nodes.label: Done check
nodes.rationale: Every step gives doc links, exact commands and a runnable done check (test, curl, or workflow run).

nodes.label: Learning mode
nodes.rationale: User learns Rust the hard way; Claude never writes Rust solutions, only explains, links docs, gives hints and failing tests.

nodes.label: Non-Rust glue allowed
nodes.rationale: docker-compose, .env.example, curl, n8n/Dify config may be written directly by Claude.

nodes.label: Primary docs only
nodes.rationale: No blogs/Medium/Stack Overflow as primary links; Rust Book, std, docs.rs, tokio, n8n, Dify, Ollama, Anthropic, Qdrant docs.

nodes.label: Version check before pinning
nodes.rationale: Check every crate/tool/image version with docs-lookup/Context7 or docs.rs; don't pin from memory.

nodes.label: Search response shape
nodes.rationale: source = file name only so it matches expected_sources in phase 05.

nodes.label: Evaluation set (eval/questions.jsonl)
nodes.rationale: 30-50 questions with expected_sources file names; includes unanswerable ones.

nodes.label: Held-out test split
nodes.rationale: Keep every eval question out of training to avoid overfitting leakage.

nodes.label: Phase 08 — Optional: LoRA fine-tune with MLX, and when it beats RAG
nodes.norm_label: phase 08 — optional: lora fine-tune with mlx, and when it beats rag

nodes.label: Bounded concurrency
nodes.rationale: Semaphore or buffer_unordered; limit concurrent embed calls (start with 4).

nodes.label: Ingest pipeline
nodes.rationale: read → chunk → embed → upsert; one bad file must not stop the run.

nodes.label: The Rust Book corpus
nodes.rationale: Open license, on topic, easy to sanity-check answers.

nodes.label: Deterministic point id
nodes.rationale: Hash of source path + chunk index so re-ingest overwrites instead of duplicating.
